card.name: Linking words in surgical procedure descriptions
card.fires_on: Small linking words or partway-through-word pieces right before a procedure or technique term, mostly in surgical, endoscopic or catheter settings (e.g. 'open' before heart surgery, 'via' before endoscopy).

modes.label: Linking word before a method
modes.description: A short word like with, via, of or undergoing that comes just before a procedure or technique name.

modes.label: Inside procedure names
modes.description: A middle piece of a long procedure word such as translum-inal or intracath-eter.
modes.example: permanent pacemaker following percutaneous translum<<inal>> septal myocardial ablation.
